ml-2fHp.title: Coverage: modern mosque, light blue walls
ml-2fHp.summary: An empty modern mosque with light blue walls and a pink floor inside. Outside is a yard with yellow and orange concrete walls. The location is badly misplaced, actually in an unidentifiable rural area.

ml-3Kim.title: Landscape: rocky gorge with dry trees
ml-3Kim.summary: A natural rocky gorge with dry trees and bushes along the path. It is the only fully rural coverage in the country.

ml-45cw.title: Mosque interior: round archways, red carpet
ml-45cw.summary: Yellow painted walls, wide round archways and red carpet.

ml-667p.title: Mosque interior: blue carpet, low ceiling
ml-667p.summary: Blue carpet, yellow walls and a fairly low ceiling held up by wooden beams.

ml-DTe5.title: Road: sand with bread-slice tiles
ml-DTe5.summary: Roads are sand mixed with tiles shaped like bread slices, unique in this country. Buildings are peachy-orange brick, as at the other two mosques in the same town. It looks busier than the third mosque.

ml-EydB.title: Mosque interior: dark, gothic arches
ml-EydB.summary: Quite dark inside, with a high roof, narrow corridors with gothic arches, and a big sandy courtyard with brown wooden doors along the walls.

ml-FAZS.title: Landmark: similar mosque, closer trees
ml-FAZS.summary: Similar in style to the previous mosque, but trees grow closer to the walls, there are a few clouds, and the streets around it look narrower.

ml-H5KC.title: Coverage: misplaced shots inside a mosque
ml-H5KC.summary: Several misplaced locations sit inside one mosque's coverage: a tour business office, a classroom, a couple of streets and other odd places.

ml-IF9E.title: Houses: mud-brick mosques with sticks
ml-IF9E.summary: Nearly all tripods show old mosques built from mud bricks and adobe plaster, with wooden sticks poking from the walls. Inside are adobe walls and prayer rugs. Most have a separate indoor and outdoor part.

ml-K0Z3.title: Landmark: very sandy ground, pyramid tower
ml-K0Z3.summary: Very sandy ground around a mosque with a prominent pyramid-shaped tower.

ml-Kosp.title: Mosque interior: yellow walls, bare brick base
ml-Kosp.summary: Yellow-painted walls with an unpainted brick lower part. The courtyard has brick walls and bright square tiles on the floor.

ml-QTt1.title: Coverage: mosque exteriors look like streets
ml-QTt1.summary: Mosque exteriors can look like ordinary streets and are sometimes used in pinpointable maps. The interiors are not pinpointable, even though they sit next to their exteriors.

ml-QW7q.title: Coverage: tripods, dreamy look
ml-QW7q.summary: All coverage is a normal consumer camera on a tripod, not a backpack. It looks ethereal, with motion blur and slightly saturated colours. Other countries have tripods too.

ml-XT6Q.title: Landscape: busy sandy road, trees at mosque
ml-XT6Q.summary: One mosque stands in a busy area beside a wide, sandy, dirty road, with trees right by its walls. Find it by the Centre Commercial just north of the town centre.

ml-XmBX.title: Mosque interior: open, blue carpet, no arches
ml-XmBX.summary: Open space with a high roof, no arches and blue carpet over the whole floor.

ml-eRRN.title: Mosque interior: low plain corridors
ml-eRRN.summary: Undecorated corridors with low roofs. From the courtyard you see a pyramid-shaped structure with lots of dry branches sticking out.

ml-erxA.title: Landmark: richly decorated doors
ml-erxA.summary: Wooden doors decorated with metal details.

ml-jyYd.title: Landscape: empty reddish ground outside walls
ml-jyYd.summary: A large empty space outside the mosque walls, reddish dirt ground, and a few trees in the distance.

ml-mxqK.title: Road: rectangular tiles, brick houses
ml-mxqK.summary: Outside this mosque, brick buildings and a street paved with rectangular tiles.

ml-oafw.title: Mosque interior: European-style pillars
ml-oafw.summary: The inside has fairly detailed European-style pillars, which none of the other mosques in the country have.

ml-ozFS.title: Coverage: ten small trekkers only
ml-ozFS.summary: Only ten small trekkers across seven locations. Just memorise what they look like rather than learning country clues.

ml-vmTB.title: Landscape: dry, sandy and arid
ml-vmTB.summary: The country is arid. A sandy, dry landscape helps tell these tripods apart from most tripods elsewhere.

ml-w4yJ.title: Landmark: mosque front, clear sky
ml-w4yJ.summary: A very recognisable mosque front with some distant trees and a clear sky. Low houses around it make the area look open.
